content:
We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly the sample is the one we have access to via NMR tools. We can get carbon NMR spectra which will list chemical shifts; aromatic carbons typically around 110-160 ppm. But we need count of aromatic carbons. Could also use HSQC to correlate. But simplest: get carbon NMR and count peaks in aromatic region.

We need to call carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
